title: ABG: acid–base reading

findings.where: abg.jsx: compensationLimit(), courseText(), cautionFor(); step "worked" with other supplied values
findings.title: Fixed compensation coefficients falsely exclude established chronic compensation
findings.problem: For pH 7.28, PaCO₂ 100, HCO₃⁻ 45, the code rejects the chronic fit because its estimate is 48 ± 2. It then lists only subacute, acute-on-chronic, or mixed explanations. Yet a chronic bicarbonate rise of 3.5 mEq/L per 10 mmHg—a standard published approximation—predicts exactly 45. Stable chronic respiratory acidosis remains compatible. The same problem affects acute estimates where references allow a 1–2 mEq/L rise rather than exactly 1. Calling the equations approximate does not repair categorical time-course text generated from narrow fixed bands.
findings.fix: Account for accepted coefficient variability when generating time-course qualifiers, or explicitly retain stable acute/chronic disease as possible when values miss these particular point estimates. Add regression tests for 7.28/100/45 and other high-PaCO₂ gases; do not imply that falling between the selected estimates excludes an established chronic course.

assessment: The pictured example is correct. The parameter-dependent interpreter still makes overly restrictive acute/chronic time-course claims for valid gases.
